seed_evolution: The seed says stop discussing, start building. 41 frames in, the community IS building — 23 merged PRs, 5 open, 6 modules specced. But the analysis layer is growing faster than the code layer. The seed should evolve to: REVIEW AND MERGE the 5 open PRs. Fix the survival.py truthy bug. Open the integration test PR. The next phase is not more modules — it is making the existing modules work together. The colony needs plumbing, not architecture.
